notes: s013/s014 are split because the ASV writes two English words for κακῶς ἔχοντες; joining them as one unit headed on *sick* under rule 73 remains defensible, but rule 73 is scoped to where the English collapses the pair and here it does not.
s005 keeps *no*: no negative indefinite stands to carry the negation alone, so rules 41 and 59 do not empty the negator.
